method: R1 主会话先读 text 后写（盲读，未看 md）

facts.fact: Hattie 在 Sloan 家图书馆喝咖啡、走神，Sloan 察觉
facts.anchor: “Sorry. Drifting,” she says. “What were we talking about?”

facts.fact: Sloan 用「我刚心梗、你早发痴呆」自嘲追问她在想什么
facts.anchor: “Me fresh off a heart attack, you with early-onset dementia. What the hell’s to become of us?”

facts.fact: Hattie 想全盘说出 Tommy、Ed、Eeling，但认为现在不行
facts.anchor: There’s nothing more she’d like to do than tell her best friend everything: Tommy, Ed, Eeling, all of it.

facts.fact: Sloan 说她一下午都心不在焉、在他出院第一天
facts.anchor: “Bullshit. You’ve been miles away all afternoon. And on my first day home from the hospital.

facts.fact: Sloan 早知道她把 Mottles 凝脂奶油换成 Worthington’s Best 骗他
facts.anchor: “That you were passing off Mottles as Worthington’s Best? Of course.

facts.fact: Sloan 说心脏康复每天多走一点、Adam 帮他练阻力带
facts.anchor: “Walking a little farther every day. And Adam’s helping me with the resistance bands.”

facts.fact: Sloan 说奶油饼干是他一周的亮点，但临别时否认是「因为食物」
facts.anchor: Sloan blinks at the brilliance of the bay and turns to look at her, the corner of his mouth quirked. “It wasn’t the food.”
